Hi team,

Looping you in on Asteria's marketplace intake. They want to publish a bundled SKU across Azure and GCP with a co-sell / revenue-share component. Key asks from their side:

- Clarify SKU mapping to our public SKUs (metering + entitlements)
- Define the cooperative revenue split and applicable refunds/credits policy
- Service-level ownership for billed-consumed adjustments and chargeback windows

I've attached a starting spreadsheet with SKU rows and suggested rev-share columns (SKU_revenue_matrix_v1.xlsx).

Asks for this thread:
- Olga: can you confirm whether we can expose the SKU-level metering keys they need and any gating for publisher bundles?
- Ben: what's the earliest we can provide a sample contract clause for the rev-share and refunds?
- Rafael: can you own the intake call with Asteria (30 min) to align on legal/ops expectations?

Proposed time: Thu 11/05 10:00-10:30 PT — I can send a calendar invite after Rafael confirms.

Thanks Karthik — and hi Rafael / Olga.

Appreciate the starter matrix. A couple of quick constraints from our legal/finance side:

- We need to restrict the publisher SKU to a single entitlement id per cloud provider for the initial launch window (no concurrent cross-cloud SKUs).
- Standard coop split we target is 70/30 (publisher/platform), but we have accelerator discounts that can change effective split during trials.
- Refunds/credits: we handle refunds on our side for direct chargebacks; for marketplace-billed usage we request a 60-day lookback for adjustments.

Attaching our standard coop term sheet for your ops/legal review (Asteria_coop_terms.pdf).

Happy to take the 11/05 slot — if you want, send an invite and we’ll lock it.

Best,
Susan Wu
Head of Channel & Marketplaces
Asteria Cloud

Attachment: Asteria_coop_terms.pdf (PDF, 128KB)
